summary: Add native mission and step escalation policy declarations without delivery behavior

replay.detail: No history rewrite or reconciliation change.

schema.detail: Optional mission and step escalation lists participate in canonical mission revisions. Existing declarations remain unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule change.

compatibility.detail: Upgrade all readers before publishing escalation nodes; older parsers reject these nodes. No protocol or harness change.

manual.detail: For any starting version without escalation support, upgrade all readers before authoring policies. No intermediate migration or backfill is required. Policies do not deliver notifications or asks in this slice.

recovery.detail: Remove escalation declarations and republish before rolling back to a reader without escalation support.
